subject: HOLD the ethan_cai run (Ethan changed the comparison)
body: Ethan wants the comparison to be no profile vs a SynthesizeMe model only. On his 4 held-out answers SynthesizeMe (m2) does not beat no profile: p(his) 0.53 vs 0.54, acc 3/4 vs 3/4. So there is no predictive model to run yet. Ignore my two earlier messages; don't run ethan_cai from usermodel.json (that file is m1 raw history, not SynthesizeMe).
